scan_lock_separation_experiment.conclusion: Initial five pairs per workload showed a 30.6% directory-heavy median reduction and 2.2% file-heavy regression. Ten confirmation pairs showed 16.1% directory-heavy reduction and 7.2% file-heavy regression; uncontrolled load and overlapping ranges do not establish a stable general gain. Production retains one shared lock. Checkpoints were already batched at 128 entries; no duplicate batching optimization was added.

unused_measurement_index_experiment.consumer_audit: At experiment time, repository search found forEachChildDirectory only at its definition, with no production or test caller. Both native measurement paths collect directories without this SQL index. A subsequent 600-directory cursor regression now calls the method; there is still no production caller.
unused_measurement_index_experiment.conclusion: Ten alternating pairs per workload: file-heavy medians 0.265/0.261 s and directory-heavy 0.160/0.160 s do not establish scan-time improvement. Directory-heavy catalog median size decreases 1,415,168 to 1,320,960 bytes. All fields and aggregates match; final published schema and safety contracts remain unchanged.
